lines.text: Can I demand.
lines.plainText: Can I demand

lines.text: But I can give thee more,
lines.plainText: But I can give thee more

lines.text: For I will raise her statue in pure gold,
lines.plainText: For I will raise her statue in pure gold

lines.text: That whiles Verona by that name is known,
lines.plainText: That whiles Verona by that name is known

lines.text: There shall no figure at such rate be set
lines.plainText: There shall no figure at such rate be set

lines.text: As that of true and faithful Juliet.
lines.plainText: As that of true and faithful Juliet

lines.text: As rich shall Romeo's by his lady's lie,
lines.plainText: As rich shall Romeo's by his lady's lie

lines.text: Poor sacrifices of our enmity.
lines.plainText: Poor sacrifices of our enmity

lines.text: A glooming peace this morning with it brings;
lines.plainText: A glooming peace this morning with it brings

lines.text: The sun for sorrow will not show his head.
lines.plainText: The sun for sorrow will not show his head

lines.text: Go hence, to have more talk of these sad things.
lines.plainText: Go hence to have more talk of these sad things

lines.text: Some shall be pardon'd, and some punished,
lines.plainText: Some shall be pardon'd and some punished

lines.text: For never was a story of more woe
lines.plainText: For never was a story of more woe

lines.text: Than this of Juliet and her Romeo.
lines.plainText: Than this of Juliet and her Romeo
